{{For|thee similarly named [[Aes Sedai]] and [[Sitter]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]|Romanda Cassin}}
'''Cassin''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Aethan Dor]]'' of the [[Goshien]].

== Appearance ==
He is tall and lean with yellow hair.

== Activities ==
He is one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s guards in [[Caemlyn]]. He is guarding Rand, when Rand meets with Elder [[Haman]], [[Covril]] and [[Erith]].
